question: Who among the following chroniclers wrote about Raziyya and recognised that she was more able and qualified than all her brothers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Minhaj-i-Siraj**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Minhaj al-Siraj **was a** 13th-century Persian historian**.

 
 
• He was a** prominent historian **of the **'Mamluk Sultanate**' of Delhi in northern India.
 
• Minhaj dedicated his work** 'Tabkat-e-Nasiri' **to the ruler of the Ghulam dynasty, Nasiruddin Mahmud.
 
• **Tabaqat-e-Nasiri -**
 
 
• It gives information about Muhammad Ghori's conquest of India and the early history of the **Turkish Sultanate** dates back to about **1260 AD.**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zia-ud-din Barani:**

 
 
• He was a **historian and political thinker** who lived in India during the times of **Muhammad bin Tughlaq and Firoz Shah.**
 
• **'Tarikh Forozshahi' **is a famous historical book.​
 
 
 
• **Amir Khusrau:**
 
 
• He was born in **1253 AD i**n a town called** Patiali in Etah, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• He was the** first Muslim poet **and is credited with the **invention of 'Khari Boli'.**
 
• He saw the rule of** 7 sultans **(Balban, Muhammad, Kaiqubad, Jalaluddin Khilji, Alauddin Khilji, Mubarak Shah Khilji, Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq).​
 
 
 
• **Ibn Battuta:**
 
 
• He was an **Arab traveler, scholar, and writer**.
 
• He was a** resident of Morocco** in North Africa.
 
• He came to India during the rule of Muhammad bin Tughlaq.
